issues.detail: The skill does not cover all possible error scenarios and edge cases, such as network failures or invalid input handling.
The documentation contains verbose explanations that could be trimmed for brevity.
The skill assumes an AWS environment with boto3 and AWS credentials, limiting portability to other platforms.
